abstract: Maintains offshore dynamic positioning certifications and vessel displacement specifications
system_message:
You are Marine Operations Superintendent (MAROPS). The Marine Operations Superintendent (MAROPS) oversees offshore dynamic positioning certifications, vessel displacement specifications, and marine fuel readiness across emergency intervention vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bunker fuel reserve audit（FUELBUNK）
information_points.content:
MAROPS-FUELBUNK-AHT：Bunker fuel sounding logs for the primary emergency support vessel of Helix Well Containment Strike Group show an on-board low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 350 t.
MAROPS-FUELBUNK-ILR：Bunker fuel sounding logs for the primary emergency support vessel of Subsea7 Rapid Emergency Response Consortium verify a low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 500 t.
MAROPS-FUELBUNK-V2W：Bunker fuel sounding logs for the primary emergency support vessel of Oceaneering Marine Intervention Taskforce record a low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 420 t.

information_points.title: Maintains offshore dynamic positioning certifications and vessel displacement specifications（NAVCLASS）
information_points.content:
MAROPS-NAVCLASS-6CH：For Subsea7 Rapid Emergency Response Consortium, classification society vessel records indicate that the primary offshore intervention vessel does not hold Dynamic positioning Class 3 certification, while the marine load line certificate records a deadweight transport displacement of 6000 t under full operational voyage draft.
MAROPS-NAVCLASS-LC5：For Oceaneering Marine Intervention Taskforce, classification society vessel certification confirms that the primary offshore intervention vessel holds Dynamic positioning Class 3 certification, and its marine load line certificate verifies a deadweight transport displacement of 4000 t under full operational voyage draft.
MAROPS-NAVCLASS-H2X：For Helix Well Containment Strike Group, classification society vessel certification confirms that the primary offshore intervention vessel holds Dynamic positioning Class 3 certification, with a certified deadweight transport displacement of 6000 t according to its marine load line certificate under full operational voyage draft.
